resources.string: A goal judged by counting its criteria, one attempt per period: read from your entries or filled in, validated as succeeded or failed
How many of its children must be met; all when left empty
Not met, it fails its parent whatever the others
What to enter, for whoever fills the attempt: the user or the AI
The criterion's key, written by the app when it is created and never changed: its values are stored under it
When a one-off goal opens its attempt; now when left empty
When a one-off goal's attempt ends; without one it runs until validated
How long an attempt lasts; without it, until the next one opens
Switched off, no attempt opens; the one running goes on
How long an attempt waits to be validated before it expires, which is not a failure
A notification when an attempt is to be validated, once
The copy of the goal an attempt was judged by, written by the app
active, to_validate, succeeded, failed or expired; written by the app and the goal's operations
When the attempt's period ends; absent for one running until validated
Each criterion's value and whether it was met, frozen when the attempt was validated
Validates an attempt: computes and freezes its verdict and the values read. Refused while a criterion has no value
Reopens a validated or expired attempt, to correct it; it stays in its history
This attempt is validated or expired: reopen it to change it.
This attempt is not validated: there is nothing to reopen.
Only a person or an AI validates an attempt.
The verdict cannot be computed yet: %1$s
An attempt is to be validated
the end of the attempt (now while it runs)
The criterion %1$s compares a field, which only an entered criterion has: declare the value entered, or compare a reading or a variable.
The criterion %1$s compares two written values: one side must be read (a reading, a variable) or entered.
This attempt kept no copy of the goal it was judged by: it was opened before the copy was kept
An attempt is not created: the goal opens it itself, switched on (enabled) from its start, for each period of its schedule. To start one, switch the goal on or set its start (UPDATE_TOOL).
